subject: maths
question: A sum becomes two times in 4 years at a certain rate of simple interest. Find the time (in years) in which the same amount will be seven times at the same rate of interest.
solution:
**Given:**

A sum becomes two times in 4 years at a certain rate of simple interest.

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest formula: A = P(1 + rt)

Where A is the amount, P is the principal, r is the rate of interest per year, and t is the time in years.

**Calculation:**

Let the principal amount be P and the rate of interest be r.

After 4 years, the amount becomes 2P.

Using the simple interest formula:

2P = P(1 + 4r)

⇒ 2 = 1 + 4r

⇒ 4r = 1

⇒ r = 1/4

We need to find the time (t) in which the amount becomes seven times the principal (7P):

Using the simple interest formula again:

7P = P(1 + rt)

⇒ 7 = 1 + (1/4)t

⇒ 7 - 1 = (1/4)t

⇒ 6 = (1/4)t

⇒ t = 6 × 4

⇒ t = 24

**The time in which the same amount will be seven times at the same rate of interest is 24 years.**
